AssociateCertificate.name: AssociateCertificate
AssociateCertificate.documentation: Associates an ACM certificate with the specified Proxy.

CreateProxy.name: CreateProxy
CreateProxy.documentation: Creates a proxy. A proxy is a fully managed, Envoy-based proxy that runs your Envoy configuration on Amazon EC2 instances inside your own virtual private cloud (VPC). AWS provisions and scales the proxy, upgrades the Envoy version, patches the operating system, and monitors its health.

DisassociateCertificate.name: DisassociateCertificate
DisassociateCertificate.documentation: Disassociates an ACM certificate from the specified proxy.

GetProxyAttributes.name: GetProxyAttributes
GetProxyAttributes.documentation: Retrieves the attributes for the specified proxy.

GetProxyConfigurationContents.name: GetProxyConfigurationContents
GetProxyConfigurationContents.documentation: Retrieves the configuration file, the configuration archive, or both for the specified proxy. This operation is separate from GetProxy so that you can grant access to proxy metadata without granting access to the configuration content.

GetProxyUpdate.name: GetProxyUpdate
GetProxyUpdate.documentation: Retrieves information about the specified proxy update.

ListCertificateAssociations.name: ListCertificateAssociations

ListProxies.name: ListProxies
ListProxies.documentation: Lists the proxies owned by the caller account.

ListProxyUpdates.name: ListProxyUpdates
ListProxyUpdates.documentation: Lists the updates for the specified proxy, most recently submitted first.

ListTagsForResource.name: ListTagsForResource
ListTagsForResource.documentation: Lists the tags for the specified resource.

TagResource.name: TagResource
TagResource.documentation: Adds the specified tags to the specified resource.

UntagResource.name: UntagResource
UntagResource.documentation: Removes the specified tags from the specified resource.

UpdateProxyAttributes.name: UpdateProxyAttributes
UpdateProxyAttributes.documentation: Updates the attributes for the specified proxy.

UpdateProxyConfiguration.name: UpdateProxyConfiguration
UpdateProxyConfiguration.documentation: Updates the configuration for the specified proxy. You can update the configuration file, the configuration archive, or both.

UpdateProxyNetworkConfiguration.name: UpdateProxyNetworkConfiguration
UpdateProxyNetworkConfiguration.documentation: Updates the network configuration for the specified proxy.

documentation: Elastic Load Balancing for Envoy is a fully managed service that runs the open-source Envoy proxy on your behalf. You bring your Envoy configuration, and AWS provisions the proxy, scales it, upgrades the Envoy version, patches the operating system, and monitors its health. The proxy runs on Amazon EC2 instances inside your own virtual private cloud (VPC), so you keep full control of your network, security groups, and IAM.
